(a) Where existing, the fuel jettisoning valve must be designed to allow UAV crew to close the valve during any part of the jettisoning operation.
(b) There must be an indication compliant with USAR.1831, adjacent to the jettison control to warn the UAV crew against jettisoning fuel while any means (including flaps, slots and slats) of changing the airflow across or around the wings is in use, unless it is shown that using such means does not adversely affect fuel jettisoning.
(c) Fuel jettisoning control must be designed to prevent inadvertent operation

(a) Where existing, the fuel jettisoning valve must be designed to allow UAS crew to close the valve during any part of the jettisoning operation.

(c) Fuel jettisoning control must be designed to prevent inadvertent operation.
